name: Remocn
tagline: Copy-paste components for building videos in Remotion
description: A shadcn-style registry scoped entirely to Remotion: text reveals, transitions, UI blocks, shader dissolves and icon animations, each installed as owned code with a live @remotion/player preview on every page. Worth a look for kinetic-type technique even outside a Remotion project.

best.title: Typography
best.note: 40+ text reveal, kinetic type and glitch effects.

best.title: Transitions
best.note: Shader-driven dissolves: grain, dither, perlin, smoke.
